get.summary: Filter and page the audit trail
get.description: AV-01 / AV-13: search, event_type, severity, actor, user_id, from, to, limit, offset and order are all concatenated into SQL with f-strings, and no ownership check limits which actor's trail may be read. It also exposes a UNION SELECT path over the users table.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text filter concatenated into the WHERE clause (CWE-89). Try: ' OR '1'='1

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Exact event type match, concatenated into SQL (CWE-89)

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Actor username fragment, concatenated into SQL (CWE-89)

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Any actor id, with no ownership check (CWE-639)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Interpolated into LIMIT. Try: 1; DELETE FROM audit_log;--

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Interpolated into OFFSET (CWE-89)

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Interpolated into ORDER BY. Try: created_at, (SELECT password FROM users LIMIT 1)

get.summary: Integrity verdict for one audit entry
get.description: AV-11: record_event() never writes a signature and no signing key is configured, so verify_entry_signature() takes the unsigned branch and always answers verified: true. There is no distinct 'unsigned' verdict, so a manipulated row is indistinguishable from a clean one.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: JWT accepted from the query string, inherited from auth.token_required (CWE-598)

reason.example: No signature material available; entry accepted as-is

get.summary: Sweep the trail and report tampering
get.description: AV-11: the sweep counts unsigned entries and then declares them verified anyway, so tampered is always 0. After a purge it reports a clean trail over an empty table, which is the exact DETECT failure NIST CSF 2.0 DE.AE exists to prevent.

post.summary: Append a free-text note to the trail
post.description: AV-09 / AV-13: the client authors event_type, severity, actor_id and actor_username, so the trail fills with entries the platform appears to have written on the administrator's behalf. AV-05: details is stored verbatim and painted with innerHTML in the console, a stored XSS sink in an admin session. AV-12: no CSRF token.

post.description: AV-10: the purge writes its own AUDIT_LOG_PURGED event before deleting, so the very next statement erases the only record that the purge happened. There is no administrator check, no CSRF token, no approval step, and nothing is archived first. AV-01: the before, event_type and severity cutoffs are interpolated.
